answers.core: Having to maintain something that's essentially a worse version of a built-in engine feature is a liability and a waste of developer time and I do not see a reason why not to expose the node's unique scene ID for usage.
answers.workaround: We are currently making the encounters tool scripts and on ready setting the current unix time as a pseudo unique ID then storing _that_ in an array for completed battles.

title: Expose the node's new Unique ID
